purpose: Objective promotion criterion from the V29 baseline to the Thompson 72-hour summer gate.
pass_condition: At each endpoint, the candidate strictly reduces absolute cloud_deficit and absolute rain_deficit relative to the listed baseline values; the candidate report must be PASS_NON_PROMOTING and CLOUD_PATHWAY_CORRECTION; and the candidate model publication must be PASS with its ready marker.
failure_action: Record the Thompson correction as a falsified mechanism-specific intervention. Do not start the summer gate or claim an inconclusive causal result.
